content: Introducing Hacker Papers! I absolutely love this HackerTube idea from @karpathy. So I took his prompt and similar data sources and asked my agent to build the arXiv papers version of it. Absolute bangers there. Find all 1K+ papers here: https://academy.dair.ai/papers/collections/hacker-papers Weekend hack: HackerTube. I was annoyed with YouTube's recommendations so I had Claude filter down 43M comments over 20 years of HN to 6,454 videos that keep being recommended. *Significantly* better viewing experience, ~2 hours with Opus 5.5: https://hackertube.org/ - Excellent…
The Computer Science collection is fire! You can also filter by year and sort them.
